title: Gradual latency climb on recommendation-service then 5xx
symptoms: RSS well above the usual band for that service
latency growing in step with memory, not with a sudden traffic spike
increase in 5xx responses seen by callers
observed_signals: CPU increased only moderately until GC became frequent
GC pause time and heap-used warnings increased with memory
after a restart, memory dropped and then began climbing again

timeline.event: a library bump shipped on recommendation-service
memory_usage on recommendation-service began a near-linear climb
p95 latency on recommendation-service moved with memory
restart or rollback dropped RSS; latency followed

contributing_factors: a library upgrade retained objects that should have been released
GC hid the problem until pauses became visible
resolution: rolled back the library version that retained extra objects
captured a heap dump before the second restart
added a slow memory-growth monitor (15-minute slope)
lessons_learned: heap dumps need to be taken before the second crash
page on sustained memory slope, not only on OOM
